map.四个公式哪个最准？: Which of the four formulas is most accurate?
map.Epley 最常用且在 reps≤10 较准；Brzycki 与之接近；Lomb: Epley is the most common and fairly accurate for reps≤10; Brzycki is close to it; Lombardi is more conservative; Mayhew is steadier at higher reps. Averaging smooths single-formula bias, but all are estimates.
map.能做几次最准？: How many reps give the most accurate estimate?
map.1–10 次内估算可靠，次数越多误差越大；rep 越少（如 3 次）越接近真实: Estimates are reliable within 1-10 reps, with greater error at higher reps; fewer reps (e.g. 3) are closer to the true 1RM. This tool limits reps to 1-12; beyond that, test with fewer reps or lower expectations.
